axis: FP32 ONNX vs A2 INT8 ONNX, decoded-plan level (adapter onnx)
reading: Across 747 cases in four cohorts the INT8 model produces exactly the same decoded plan as FP32: behaviour order, target ids and completion types never differ. Numbers do drift (up to 1.41 m/s on the speed head), which is why raw-tensor tolerances fail while the plan comparison passes -- a flattened-argmax metric suggested flips on some heads, but the decoder is unaffected.
